note: Scene paintings are WebP files at assets/games/lamp/<image>.webp. Verses are KJV text from assets/bible/text/KJV.tsv.gz.

scenes.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
scenes.prayer: Lord, lead me today and let me rest in you.

scenes.verse: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
scenes.prayer: Shine into my dark places, Lord.

scenes.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
scenes.prayer: Let your word light the next step.

scenes.verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
scenes.prayer: Help me trust you more than my own plans.

scenes.verse: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
scenes.prayer: Make me a light where I am today.

scenes.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
scenes.prayer: You are my light. I am not afraid.

scenes.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
scenes.prayer: Renew my strength while I wait for you.

scenes.verse: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
scenes.prayer: Jesus, I choose to follow you.

scenes.verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
scenes.prayer: Strengthen me for what you ask today.

scenes.verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
scenes.prayer: Be my refuge when things feel hard.

scenes.verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
scenes.prayer: Work your good purpose in my life.

scenes.verse: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
scenes.prayer: Thank you for the love that gives life.
